# The Citation Agency

> The Citation Agency is a digital marketing agency based in the Phoenix East Valley (San Tan Valley & Queen Creek, AZ) that operates hyper-local service directories and builds mobile-first, search-ready websites and public visibility audits for local service businesses—with zero monthly retainers and zero Google login required.
> Main site: https://thecitationagency.com/
> Contact: contact@thecitationagency.com

## Flagship Local Directory
- **San Tan Valley Pros** (`https://santanvalleypros.thecitationagency.com/`): Independent local service directory covering the Town of San Tan Valley & Queen Creek, AZ (ZIPs 85140–85144) — San Tan Valley edition registry tracking 100+ local businesses (18,900+ public Google reviews, live totals updated automatically) with 10 featured live interactive website previews.
- **Live Working Example (K&O Landscaping & Handyman Services LLC):** Directory listing (`https://santanvalleypros.thecitationagency.com/#pro-k-o-landscaping-handyman-services-llc`) → Visibility snapshot (`https://santanvalleypros.thecitationagency.com/pros/k-o-landscaping-handyman-services-llc/`) → Interactive website preview (`https://santanvalleypros.thecitationagency.com/previews/k-o-landscaping-handyman-services-llc/`) → $300 one-time claim options (`https://santanvalleypros.thecitationagency.com/pros/k-o-landscaping-handyman-services-llc/#claim-options`).

## One-Time 3-Step Ladder (Zero Retainers · Zero Google Login Required)
- **Step 1 — Written Public Visibility Check ($19 one-time — Find the gaps):** Deterministic 10-point live technical audit & copy-paste fix pack (HTTPS redirects, crawler access, LocalBusiness schema parity, titles, phone links, and local ZIP signals) formatted for your web person or hosting provider.
- **Step 2 — AI Search-Ready Local Website ($300 one-time — Get the website files):** Completed mobile-first local service website package (services, local ZIP coverage, customer FAQ, quote form, and matching LocalBusiness JSON-LD) delivered within 48 hours of detail approval with 1 revision round included. Self-service handoff: client retains 100% ownership of website files, hosting account, and domain (ready for Netlify, Cloudflare Pages, or any preferred host).
- **Step 3 — 1-on-1 Setup & Walkthrough Session ($149 one-time — Deploy it together):** Optional live 30-minute screen-share session with you or your web/IT person for guided Netlify/Cloudflare Pages deployment, DNS setup, or live visibility fix walkthrough (zero passwords handed over).

## Positioning Boundaries
- The Citation Agency does not control Google, ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or Perplexity and never guarantees rankings, AI recommendations, or lead counts.
- Delivery is 100% front-end and structured-data focused; we never ask for a client's Google Business Profile password or admin login.
